title: TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.25798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires adapting to contact states that can evolve substantially within an action horizon. However, chunk-based vision-language-action models predict complete action chunks from observations collected before execution, leaving tactile conditioning stale during execution. Existing tactile-reactive approaches typically rely on separate high-frequency controllers, which increase both architectural and training complexity. In this paper, we introduce TacForcing, a streaming action-generation framework that effectively incorporates execution-time tactile feedback. Instead of employing a separate reactive controller, TacForcing replaces the standard action expert with a streaming action expert to generate actions conditioned on the evolving tactile observations acquired during execution. TacForcing also introduces Execution-Aware Tactile Attention (EATA), which restricts tactile conditioning to actions nearing exec

translated_title: TacForcing：利用执行时触觉反馈的流式动作生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25798v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：接触丰富的操作需要适应在动作时间范围内可能显著演变的接触状态。然而，基于分块的视觉-语言-动作模型从执行前收集的观察中预测完整动作块，导致执行过程中触觉条件变得过时。现有的触觉反应式方法通常依赖独立的高频控制器，这增加了架构和训练的复杂性。在本文中，我们引入了TacForcing，一种流式动作生成框架，有效整合执行时的触觉反馈。TacForcing不采用独立的反应式控制器，而是用流式动作专家替代标准动作专家，以根据执行过程中演变的触觉观察生成动作。TacForcing还引入了执行感知触觉注意力（EATA），该机制将触觉条件限制在即将执行的动作上。
tldr: TacForcing通过流式动作专家和执行感知触觉注意力机制，在动作生成过程中实时整合触觉反馈，避免了传统反应式控制器的复杂性，从而提升了接触丰富操作的自适应能力。
en_tdlr: TacForcing integrates real-time tactile feedback during action generation via a streaming action expert and Execution-Aware Tactile Attention, avoiding the complexity of reactive controllers to enhance adaptability in contact-rich manipulation.
